org.name: DGTL Group
org.about: DGTL Group is a creative and B2B marketing agency (dgtlgroup.io) with a confident, energetic, results-first voice and a black + gold (#F0CF50), Manrope visual identity. Services span web design & custom software, influencer & creator campaigns, brand activations, DTC ecommerce scaling, content production, and paid media. Brands in DGTL's client/portfolio logo set include Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Audi, Lexus, Ford, Hyundai, Canon, DJI, Anker, On Running, Arc'teryx, PolarPro, Epidemic Sound, Corona, Six Senses Ibiza, CanaDream, Rotary, Guilds Garage, and Swae Lee. DGTL also builds its own products and an internal platform — e.g. DGTL Decks, DGTL Social, a deploy portal at deploy.dgtlmedia.io, and this DGTL OS terminal (terminal.dgtlmedia.io) — running on a self-hosted stack (Traefik, Ollama, TwentyCRM, n8n, Mautic, Plausible, Gitea, Frappe, MinIO).
